summary.en: A school roof collapsed in Peshawar, killing dozens of children and a teacher. Families of the victims are demanding justice for the children killed in the collapse. The Taliban and Russia are drawing closer, increasing regional tension as Pakistan imposes emergency rule in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. An emergency border response is underway in Afghanistan, as detailed in a ReliefWeb report covering late September to early October 2026. The conflict in the region produced 1,794 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Et skole tak kollapset i Peshawar, og drepte dusinvis av barn og en lærer. Familiene til ofrene krever rettferdighet for barna som ble drept i kollapsen. Taliban og Russland kommer nærmere hverandre, noe som øker spenningen i regionen mens Pakistan innfører nødregjering i Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. En nødrespons ved grensen er i gang i Afghanistan, som beskrevet i en ReliefWeb-rapport som dekker slutten av september til begynnelsen av oktober 2026. Konflikten i regionen førte til 1 794 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
background.extract: Since 2004, an insurgency has been fought in the Pakistani province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa by Islamist militant groups such as the Tehrik-i-Taliban Pakistan (TTP), Jundallah, Lashkar-e-Islam (LeI), the Tehreek-e-Nafaz-e-Shariat-e-Mohammadi (TNSM), Al-Qaeda, and their Central Asian allies such as the Islamic State – Khorasan Province (ISKP), Islamic Movement of Uzbekistan, East Turkistan Movement, Jamaat-ul-Ahrar, Ittihad-ul-Mujahideen Pakistan, and elements of organised crime. Before being transformed into an insurgency in 2017, the conflict was a war.
